judge: Claude Code subagent, Claude Opus 5.5, fresh
critique: The officious rule list with the anti-wizardry jab, the afterthought 'Oh, I forgot to mention, no loitering', and the trailing-ellipsis 'Here for [Place], huh...' are exactly the short, comic guard barks of a warrior town in Nox. Nothing over-written or explanatory gives it away.
